nodes.label: Similar-URL suggestion script (Levenshtein)
nodes.rationale: Suggests an existing page whose path (full, or last segment within a third of its length) is a few letters away from the mistyped URL.

nodes.label: product-catalog JSON
nodes.rationale: Current prices and names: the cart takes them from here, not from what the browser saved.

nodes.label: Photo publication opt-out checkbox
nodes.rationale: Finished-piece photos may be published based on legitimate interest; reference photos never are, and the customer can object at any time.

nodes.label: Sent confirmation and auto-clear countdown
nodes.rationale: The cart empties itself after 10:00 so the customer does not repeat the order by accident.

nodes.label: Order via WhatsApp link
nodes.rationale: The order is not sent or confirmed automatically; the user reviews and sends a prepared message, and details and final price are agreed in the chat.
